# Security policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

## Private reporting

Report security concerns privately using
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/dangkhoa2016/Multilingual-Translation-AI-Inference/security/advisories),
when available, or contact **Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>**.

Do not publish access tokens, private input text, exploit details or
sensitive configuration in issues or pull requests.

## Scope

This is an independently operated inference service. Operators manage
their own cloud accounts, credentials, network settings and data
retention. Keep environment files outside version control.

See [configuration](../docs/configuration.md) and
[contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md). Security reports are coordinated
privately before disclosure.
